the personality of a chatbot affects the behavior of the user and that the user's personality traits influence the behavior of the chatbot.
users' willingness to confide and listen to a personality-based intelligent virtual interviewer is affected by the personality of the interviewer, as well as users' personality traits.

the question of whether and how a virtual interviewer can influence a user's behavior.

we found that users are more willing and likely to confide in a virtual interviewer with an assertive, serious personality.
we have developed two virtual agents with distinct personalities, deployed them in a large scale recruiting event, and analyzed the effect of personality traits on user behavior.
the results from the current study show that the personality of a conversational agent has an effect on the user's willingness confide in the virtual agent and listen to the virtual agent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the personality of an agent influences the behavior of a user, and the user's traits influence his or her perception of and interaction with an intelligent agent.

users are more willing confide and listen to a serious and assertive virtual interviewer, and that their own personality traits influence their perception of the virtual interviewer and their willingness to interact with it.

personality plays a significant role in how users engage with intelligent agents.
